prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one standalone professional image for an Arabic family visual guessing game (age 16+).
Subject: a complete traditional Scottish bagpipe with bag, chanter and three drones.
Style: realistic high quality photography with correct anatomy and object geometry, clean natural textures.
Composition: landscape 4:3, the complete subject fills about 75% of the frame; centered with ample margins, immediately recognizable when revealed.  
Background: simple uncluttered setting appropriate to the subject, natural lighting.
Constraints: exactly the stated subject; no label, caption, watermark, collage, borders or readable words. Create a sharp original, not a blurred image; the game applies the blur.  The subject must be visually unambiguous, with a strong clear outline and identifying features large enough to survive a moderate blur. Do not add any text or split-panel layout. Keep the entire subject in frame.
Instrument accuracy: show one cloth-covered inflated bag, exactly three long drone pipes emerging from it, one blowpipe with mouthpiece and one finger-holed chanter. Separate all pipes clearly so the structure is plausible; no extra pipes. Entire instrument inside the frame.
